subject: Mutual Action Plan: security gates, DPA redlines & close timeline (Crestline)
messages:
From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@crestline.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: security-ops@crestline.com, procurement@crestline.com
Date: Tue, 26 Sep 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery + MAP kickoff

Jordan — thanks for the intro call earlier. Crestline is aligned to move forward but we need a crisp mutual action plan that explicitly calls out the security/compliance gates and associated acceptance deadlines.

High-level asks from our side:
- SOC 2: do you have the latest SOC 2 Type II report and timeframe for evidence access (read-only)?
- SIG/CAIQ: we prefer the full SIG spreadsheet; can you return a completed SIG for our security team within two weeks?
- DPA: procurement will need any redlines in PDF; we will push legal after your redlines land.
- Data retention: we need a clear retention table showing default retention, EU residency options, and an archival/escrow path.

I attached our intake SIGQ and a high-level procurement checklist. Proposed close target: contract execution by 2028-10-12, contingent on security acceptance (SOC 2 + SIG pass + DPA comments reconciled). Is that timetable feasible on your side?

Appreciate a MAP with owners/dates so we can commit resources.

—Alex
Head of Security Partnerships
Crestline Financial

Attachments: crestline_sigq.xlsx (xlsx)

Alex — thanks for the clear list and the SIGQ. Draft MAP attached (map_master_schedule.xlsx) with proposed owners and milestones; calling out the security gates that must be green to hit a 2028-10-12 signature. Summary below: 

1) SOC 2 evidence access
   - Owner: Kimberly Park (Security PM)
   - Target: provide read-only evidence bundle by 2028-10-03
   - Acceptance: Crestline confirms no outstanding control questions within 3 business days of receipt

2) SIG/CAIQ completion
   - Owner: Jordan Blake + Kimberly Park (we will pre-fill answers and flag any items requiring architecture input)
   - Target submit: 2028-10-01 (preliminary), final: 2028-10-05

3) DPA redlines
   - Owner: Legal + Jordan Blake
   - We will circulate redline (redwood_dpa_v3_redline.pdf) by 2028-09-29. Crestline legal to return comments by 2028-10-04.

4) Data retention & residency table
   - Owner: Hannah Schmitt (Product Ops)
   - Deliverable: retention matrix (default, EU-residency, archival/escrow) by 2028-09-30

Escalation path: if any security gate is unresolved by 2028-10-05, parties escalate to VP level (Jordan / Alex) and proposed fallback is a 30-day provisional pilot with contractual guardrails.

Please confirm owners and dates, and we’ll lock the MAP and route evidence/attachments.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: map_master_schedule.xlsx (xlsx)

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: security gates, DPA redlines & close timeline (Crestline)

Jordan / Kimberly / Hannah — thank you. Owners/dates look reasonable. A few clarifying points from Crestline Security and Procurement: 

- SOC 2 access: we will need temporary/limited read-only access to the evidence folder rather than PDFs where possible. Can you confirm whether the evidence folder can be mounted for 7 days?
- SIG: security will prioritize the questions flagged as high-risk; low-risk items can be deferred to post-sign, but we need the high-risk set closed pre-signature.
- DPA: procurement requests a carveout for lawful processing when using third-party embeddings (we’ll add a comment in-line in your redline).
- Retention: need explicit RTO/RPO expectations for EU-residency option and whether deletion is verifiable within customer audit logs.

We’ll aim to get the internal legal and security comments to you by 2028-10-04 as requested.

—Alex

Attachments: none

2) Security to review high-risk SIG items by 2028-10-02 and mark acceptance or open issues.
3) Legal to return DPA comments by 2028-10-04.

If all three milestones are green, we remain on-track for counter-signature on 2028-10-12. If not, follow the escalation path in the MAP (VP review on 2028-10-05).

I’ll update the HubSpot timeline and drop final docs into the Drive folder listed below.
